title: Researcher forwards an alleged Ransone email, then vanishes

tellings.quote: And and so he forwards me an email, which is allegedly from Valerie, which

plain: A researcher who is not named on the show says that, sometime between 2010 and 2021, another man forwarded him an email said to be from a woman named Valerie Ransone, and then the man disappeared from contact. The researcher tells it as something that happened to him: "he forwards me an email, which is allegedly from Valerie." He tells it as part of a wider story about a government scientist said to have been in contact with an alien council.
